name: Steadfast
description: The Steadfast was a fleet hauler of the Rebel Alliance and later the New Republic Defense Force. It participated in the Battle of Endor and in the Battle of Coruscant against Grand Admiral Thrawn, and after the resolution of the Thrawn campaign, was modified to become a "junker" under Operation Flotsam, and transformed into a starship that searched the wrecks of starships for valuable material and data.
